info.title: API.SH: Remote.co
info.description: The Remote.co API from API.SH: public Remote.co data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Remote.co category page: the category (title, description, overview), the companies hiring most in it with their open job counts, and its jobs, 50 per page, with the same fields and filters as /remoteco/v1/search (location, remote, job_type, schedule, career_level, education, travel, title, salary, sort). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Unknown categories answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/remoteco-category

get.description:
A Remote.co company profile: name, logo, headquarters city/state/country, website, careers page, summary, social links, benefits, flexibility options (share of its jobs that are remote, full-time, part-time, freelance), job counts per category, divisions and Q&A, plus Remote.co's list of top remote companies. Remote.co shows a company's open jobs to members only. Unknown companies answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/remoteco-company

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Company slug or link (https://remote.co/company/veeva).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Veeva
example.note: Remote.co lists a company's open jobs only to members; search jobs with /remoteco/v1/search.

get.description:
One Remote.co job by link, slug or id (or the newest job with `latest=true`): title, summary, full description when the site shows it to logged-out visitors (jobs it marks free), posted, created and expiry dates, locations with coordinates, remote options and work level, schedules, job types, career levels, education levels, travel, salary ranges, benefits, categories, accolades, applicant tracking system name, company (on free jobs) and up to 10 similar jobs. Unknown jobs answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/remoteco-job

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: Job link (https://remote.co/job-details/...), slug or id.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: the newest job on the site.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches Remote.co's remote and flexible jobs with every filter the site offers: keyword, location, remote level, job type, schedule, career level, education, travel, category, job title, salary band, plus relevance or date order. 50 jobs per page, each with `id`, `slug`, `title`, `url`, `summary`, posted, created and expiry dates, locations, allowed candidate locations, countries, states, cities, remote options, schedules, job types, career levels, education levels, travel, salary text and min/max/unit/currency when given, benefits, categories, accolades, featured and free-job flags and `company` (Remote.co shows the employer's name to logged-out visitors only on jobs it marks free; otherwise null). `facets` lists every filter's values for this search, with job counts where the site shows them (titles, benefits). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/remoteco-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location (city, state or country), e.g. Canada.

parameters.name: remote
parameters.description: Remote level: 100% Remote Work, Hybrid Remote Work, Option for Remote Work, No Remote Work. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: job_type
parameters.description: Employee, Freelance or Temporary. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: schedule
parameters.description: Full-Time, Part-Time, Flexible Schedule, Alternative Schedule. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: career_level
parameters.description: Entry-Level, Experienced, Manager or Senior Level Manager. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: education
parameters.description: No Education Specified, High School Diploma, Associate's Degree or Some College, Bachelor's/Undergraduate Degree, Master's Degree, Doctorate Degree. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: travel
parameters.description: Yes, No or No specification. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug or id from /remoteco/v1/categories (comma separated).

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Job title as listed in the Title facet, e.g. Account Executive. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: salary
parameters.description: Salary band as listed in the Salary facet, e.g. 100,000 or more USD Annually. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: accolade
parameters.description: Company award name. Several values: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default) or date.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (1-based).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
